title: The Existence of Jember Fashion Carnaval (JFC) in Jember Regency–Indonesia 2003–2021
evidence: Historical study draws on interviews and published history. Useful for early dates, nested defiles and milestones. Isolated year and count errors warrant cross-checking.

evidence: Table distinguishes defiles from umbrella titles in the first three editions. It preserves variant historical spellings.

evidence: Chronology, founder’s death before the 2019 edition, costume presentation by Anne Avantie (source alternate spelling) and leadership succession.
